race.title: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap
race.verdict: The likelihood of a strong pace to aim at ought to play firmly to the strengths of CREDIT FORGEDD IT who arrives on the back of solid placed efforts and starts out for a new yard who boast a very good record with similar types. Cooramook despite a potentially tricky draw, Snaafy and The Caribbean from his reduced mark are others to consider. CREDIT FORGEDD IT (IRE) COORAMOOK (IRE) SNAAFY
